INSERT INTO HR_PRODUCT_INFO T (T.PRODUCT_NO, T.PERSON_ID, T.PRODUCT_TYPE, T.ACTIVITY, T.CREATE_DATE, T.CREATED_BY, T.PERCENT) SELECT HR_PRODUCT_INFO_SEQ.NEXTVAL, A.PERSON_ID, A.PRODUCT_TYPE, 1, A.CREATE_DATE, A.CREATED_BY, A.PERCENT FROM HR_PRODUCT_INFO_APPLY A WHERE A.PRODUCT_NO = #PRODUCT_NO#

INSERT INTO HR_QUALIFICATION T (T.QUAL_NO, T.PERSON_ID, T.QUAL_NAME, T.QUAL_LEVEL, T.QUAL_GRADE, T.DATE_OBTAINED, T.QUAL_CARD_NO, T.VALIDITY_DATE, T.QUAL_INSTITUTE, T.CREATED_IP, T.CREATED_BY, T.CREATE_DATE, T.ACTIVITY, T.QUAL_REMARK) SELECT HR_QUAL_SEQ.NEXTVAL, A.PERSON_ID, A.QUAL_NAME, A.QUAL_LEVEL, A.QUAL_GRADE, A.DATE_OBTAINED, A.QUAL_CARD_NO, A.VALIDITY_DATE, A.QUAL_INSTITUTE, A.CREATE_DATE, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATE_DATE, 1, A.QUAL_REMARK FROM HR_QUALIFICATION_APPLY A WHERE A.QUAL_NO = #QUAL_NO#
SELECT HR_QUAL_SEQ.CURRVAL AS ID FROM DUAL

INSERT INTO HR_REWARD T(T.REWARD_NO,T.PERSON_ID,T.REWARD_TYPE,T.REWARD_DATE,T.REWARD_CNPY, T.REWARD, T.CREATE_DATE, T.CREATED_BY, T.CREATED_IP, T.REMARKS, T.REWARD_TYPE_CODE, T.ACTIVITY ) SELECT HR_REWARD_SEQ.NEXTVAL,A.PERSON_ID,A.REWARD_TYPE,A.REWARD_DATE, A.REWARD_CNPY, A.REWARD, A.CREATE_DATE, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATED_IP, A.REMARKS, A.REWARD_TYPE_CODE,1 FROM HR_REWARD_APPLY A WHERE A.REWARD_NO=#REWARD_NO#

INSERT INTO HR_WORK_EXPERIENCE T(T.WORK_EXPER_NO,T.PERSON_ID,T.CPNY_NAME,T.DUTY,T.DEPT_NAME,T.POSITION, T.START_DATE, T.END_DATE, T.PAY_YEAR, T.CREATE_DATE, T.CREATED_BY, T.CREATED_IP, T.ACTIVITY, T.RESIGN_REASON, T.REMARK ) SELECT HR_W_EXP_SEQ.NEXTVAL, A.PERSON_ID, A.CPNY_NAME, A.DUTY, A.DEPT_NAME, A.POSITION, A.START_DATE, A.END_DATE, A.PAY_YEAR, A.CREATE_DATE, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATED_IP, 1, A.RESIGN_REASON, A.REMARK FROM HR_WORK_EXPERIENCE_APPLY A WHERE A.WORK_EXPER_NO=#WORK_EXPER_NO#
sqlMap.update: UPDATE HR_ADDRESS_MATTERS T SET ( T.ACTIVITY, T.UPDATE_DATE, T.UPDATED_BY, T.UPDATED_IP) = (SELECT 0, A.CREATE_DATE, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATED_IP FROM HR_ADDRESS_MATTERS_APPLY A WHERE A.ADDRESS_NO=#ADDRESS_NO#) WHERE T.ADDRESS_NO=#UPDATE_ADDRESS_NO#

UPDATE HR_EDUCATION T SET(T.UPDATE_DATE, T.UPDATED_BY, T.UPDATED_IP, T.ACTIVITY) = (SELECT A.CREATE_DATE,A.CREATED_BY,A.CREATED_IP,0 FROM HR_EDUCATION_APPLY A WHERE A.EDUC_NO = #EDUC_NO# ) WHERE T.EDUC_NO=#UPDATE_EDUC_NO#

UPDATE HR_EMERGENCY_ADDRESS T SET (T.ACTIVITY, T.UPDATE_DATE, T.UPDATED_BY, T.UPDATED_IP) = (SELECT 0,
A.CREATE_DATE, A.PERSON_ID, A.CREATED_IP FROM HR_EMERGENCY_ADDRESS_APPLY A WHERE A.EMERGENCY_NO = #EMERGENCY_NO#) WHERE T.EMERGENCY_NO = #UPDATE_EMERGENCY_NO#

UPDATE HR_FAMILY T SET ( T.UPDATE_DATE, T.UPDATED_BY, T.ACTIVITY, T.UPDATED_IP ) = (SELECT A.CREATE_DATE, A.CREATED_BY, 0, A.CREATED_IP FROM HR_FAMILY_APPLY A WHERE A.FAMILY_NO=#FAMILY_NO#) WHERE T.FAMILY_NO=#UPDATE_FAMILY_NO#

UPDATE HR_PRODUCT_INFO T SET( T.ACTIVITY,T.UPDATE_DATE,T.UPDATED_BY )=( SELECT 0,A.CREATE_DATE,A.CREATED_BY FROM HR_PRODUCT_INFO_APPLY A WHERE A.PRODUCT_NO=#PRODUCT_NO#
) WHERE T.PRODUCT_NO=#UPDATE_PRODUCT_NO#

UPDATE HR_QUALIFICATION T SET(T.ACTIVITY,T.UPDATED_IP,T.UPDATED_BY,T.UPDATE_DATE)= (SELECT 0,A.CREATE_DATE,A.CREATED_BY,A.CREATE_DATE FROM HR_QUALIFICATION_APPLY A WHERE A.QUAL_NO=#QUAL_NO# ) WHERE T.QUAL_NO=#UPDATE_QUAL_NO#

UPDATE HR_WORK_EXPERIENCE T SET(T.ACTIVITY, T.UPDATE_DATE, T.UPDATED_BY, T.UPDATED_IP
) = ( SELECT 0, A.CREATE_DATE, A.CREATED_BY, A.CREATED_IP FROM HR_WORK_EXPERIENCE_APPLY A WHERE A.WORK_EXPER_NO=#WORK_EXPER_NO# ) WHERE T.WORK_EXPER_NO=#UPDATE_WORK_EXPER_NO#
